problem_text:
A company must allocate computing tasks across a distributed network of data centers to processing nodes, aiming to minimize total latency.  

The available computational capacity at each data center (set C) is:  
*C1 can handle 130 units of workload.  
*C2 can handle 80 units of workload.  
*C3 can handle 187 units of workload.  
*C4 can handle 97 units of workload.  
*C5 can handle 99 units of workload.  

The required processing load at each node (set D) is:  
*D1 requires 65 units.  
*D2 requires 97 units.  
*D3 requires 131 units.  
*D4 requires 70 units.  
*D5 requires 37 units.  

The latency per unit of workload transferred from each data center to each processing node is given below:  

| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 |  
|--|-|-|-|-|-|  
| C1 | 4 | 7 | 10 | 8 | 12 |  
| C2 | 6 | 10 | 1 | 18 | 5 |  
| C3 | 9 | 2 | 2 | 18 | 10 |  
| C4 | 5 | 16 | 4 | 1 | 19 |  
| C5 | 10 | 16 | 16 | 15 | 11 |  

Determine the workload distribution that minimizes the overall latency.
